rubric.description: (a) Tests divisibility by 4 and excludes multiples of 100
(a) Makes multiples of 400 leap years, with correct grouping of `&&` and `||`, and returns a `boolean`
(b) Returns -1 for a month that is not between 1 and 12
(b) Returns 30 for April, June, September and November
(b) Calls `isLeapYear` to return 29 or 28 for February
(a) Checks that all three sides are positive
(a) Checks all three triangle inequalities (not only one)
(a) Combines the conditions with the correct logical operators and returns a `boolean`
(b) Calls `isTriangle` and returns "invalid" when it is false
(b) Tests for equilateral before isosceles, so that three equal sides are not classified as isosceles
(b) Tests for isosceles by comparing all three pairs of sides
